# Kafka Connector - (current)

> Explore how to use the MongoDB Kafka Connector to integrate data between Apache Kafka and MongoDB, including setup, configuration, and security.

- [Compatibility](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/compatibility.md): Ensure compatibility of the Kafka Connector with MongoDB and Confluent Kafka Connect, supporting various Apache Kafka platforms.
- [How to Contribute](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/contribute.md): Contribute to the Kafka Connector by following guidelines for code standards, documentation, and testing, ensuring your pull request passes all Gradle checks.
- [MongoDB Kafka Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/index.md): Explore how to use the MongoDB Kafka Connector to integrate data between Apache Kafka and MongoDB, including setup, configuration, and security.
- [Introduction](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/introduction.md): Explore sections on the MongoDB Kafka Connector, including installation, connection, data formats, and converters.
- [Connect to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/introduction/connect.md): Connect the MongoDB Kafka Connector to MongoDB using a connection URI, specifying address, settings, and authentication options.
- [Converters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/introduction/converters.md): Explore how to use converters with the MongoDB Kafka Connector to serialize and translate data between MongoDB and Kafka Connect, with configuration examples.
- [Data Formats](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/introduction/data-formats.md): Explore various data formats like JSON, BSON, Avro, and byte arrays used with the MongoDB Kafka Connector, including their applications and specifications.
- [Install the MongoDB Kafka Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/introduction/install.md): Install the MongoDB Kafka Connector on Confluent Platform or Apache Kafka by downloading the appropriate JAR files and following specific setup instructions.
- [Kafka and Kafka Connect](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/introduction/kafka-connect.md): Learn about Apache Kafka and Kafka Connect, their benefits, and how they facilitate data movement between datastores like MongoDB.
- [Issues & Help](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/issues-and-help.md): Find support for the Kafka Connector through community forums, report bugs, or request features via JIRA.
- [Compare Kafka Connector and Atlas Stream Processing](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/kafka-connector-atlas-stream-processing-comparison.md)
- [Migrate from Kafka Connect MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/migrate-from-kafka-connect-mongodb.md): Learn how to migrate from the community Kafka Connect MongoDB sink connector to the official MongoDB Kafka Connector by updating configuration settings.
- [Monitoring](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/monitoring.md): Monitor MongoDB Kafka Connectors using JMX to track metrics for source and sink tasks, ensuring optimal performance and identifying potential issues.
- [Kafka Connector Quick Start](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/quick-start.md): Configure the MongoDB Kafka Connector to transfer data between MongoDB and Apache Kafka using a sandbox environment.
- [Security and Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/security-and-authentication.md): Secure communications between MongoDB and the Kafka Connector by encrypting messages, authenticating with AWS, or implementing a custom authentication provider.
- [Custom Authentication Provider](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/security-and-authentication/custom-auth.md): Implement a custom authentication provider for the MongoDB Kafka Connector by extending CustomCredentialProvider and configuring AWS IAM authentication.
- [MongoDB AWS-based Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/security-and-authentication/mongodb-aws-auth.md): Authenticate the MongoDB Kafka Connector with a MongoDB replica set using AWS IAM credentials via the `MONGODB-AWS` mechanism.
- [SSL/TLS and X.509 Certificates](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/security-and-authentication/tls-and-x509.md): Learn how to secure communications between your Kafka Connector worker and MongoDB cluster using SSL/TLS and X.509 certificates.
- [Sink Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector.md): Explore how the Kafka sink connector reads data from Apache Kafka and writes it to MongoDB.
- [Sink Connector Configuration Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties.md): Explore the configuration properties for the Kafka sink connector, including MongoDB connection settings, error handling, and data transformation options.
- [All Sink Connector Configuration Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/all-properties.md): Explore all configuration properties for the MongoDB Kafka sink connector, including connection, namespace mapping, message processing, and error handling.
- [Change Data Capture Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/cdc.md): Configure the MongoDB Kafka sink connector to process change data capture events using specified CDC handlers.
- [Connector Message Processing Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/connector-message.md): Configure the message processing behavior of the Kafka sink connector with settings for batch size, rate limits, and parallel tasks.
- [Connector Error Handling Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/error-handling.md): Configure error handling and dead letter queue settings for the Kafka sink connector, including error tolerance, logging, and bulk write exception reporting.
- [Sink Connector Id Strategy Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/id-strategy.md): Configure how the Kafka sink connector determines the `_id` value for documents in MongoDB, including strategies for overwriting and UUID formatting.
- [Kafka Topic Properties for the Sink Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/kafka-topic.md): Configure which Kafka topics the MongoDB Kafka sink connector should monitor using the `topics` or `topics.regex` settings.
- [MongoDB Connection Configuration Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/mongodb-connection.md): Configure how your Kafka sink connector connects to a MongoDB cluster using connection URI, API version, and error handling settings.
- [MongoDB Namespace Mapping Configuration Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/mongodb-namespace.md): Configure MongoDB Kafka sink connector to specify target database and collection using default or custom namespace mapping classes.
- [Sink Connector Post-processor Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/post-processors.md): Configure how the Kafka sink connector transforms data before inserting it into MongoDB using post-processor properties.
- [Kafka Time Series Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/time-series.md): Configure the MongoDB Kafka sink connector to manage data in a time series collection using specific settings for time fields, metadata, and data expiration.
- [Topic Override Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/topic-override.md): Override global or default property settings for specific topics in the Kafka sink connector using topic override properties.
- [Sink Connector Write Model Strategies](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/configuration-properties/write-strategies.md): Configure how the Kafka sink connector writes data to MongoDB by setting write model strategies for handling sink records and tombstone events.
- [Sink Connector Fundamentals](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/fundamentals.md): Explore how to configure the MongoDB Kafka sink connector, including write strategies, post-processors, error handling, and change data capture handlers.
- [Change Data Capture Handlers](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/fundamentals/change-data-capture.md): Learn to replicate change data capture events using a MongoDB Kafka sink connector by configuring CDC handlers for MongoDB, Debezium, and Qlik Replicate.
- [Error Handling](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/fundamentals/error-handling-strategies.md): Learn how to handle errors in your Kafka sink connector with strategies like stopping, tolerating, or logging errors, and using dead letter queues.
- [Sink Connector Post Processors](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/fundamentals/post-processors.md): Learn how to configure and use post processors in the Kafka sink connector to modify data before storing it in MongoDB, including creating custom processors.
- [Write Model Strategies](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/sink-connector/fundamentals/write-strategies.md): Configure the MongoDB Kafka sink connector write strategies to insert, update, replace, or delete documents using bulk operations and custom strategies.
- [Source Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector.md): Explore how the MongoDB Kafka source connector reads data from MongoDB and writes it to Apache Kafka using a change stream.
- [Source Connector Configuration Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/configuration-properties.md): Explore MongoDB Kafka source connector properties, including connection, topic, change stream, output format, startup, and error handling settings.
- [All Source Connector Configuration Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/configuration-properties/all-properties.md): Explore all configuration properties for the MongoDB Kafka source connector, including connection, Kafka topic, change stream, and error handling options.
- [Change Stream Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/configuration-properties/change-stream.md): Configure change stream properties for the MongoDB Kafka source connector, including aggregation pipelines, read preferences, and document handling options.
- [Error Handling and Resuming from Interruption Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/configuration-properties/error-handling.md): Configure error handling and resumption settings for the Kafka source connector, including error tolerance, logging, dead letter queue, and heartbeat messages.
- [Kafka Topic Properties for the Source Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/configuration-properties/kafka-topic.md): Configure Kafka topic properties for the MongoDB Kafka source connector, including topic prefix, suffix, namespace mapping, separator, and custom mapping logic.
- [MongoDB Source Connection Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/configuration-properties/mongodb-connection.md): Configure how the Kafka source connector connects to and communicates with a MongoDB cluster using specific connection properties.
- [Output Format Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/configuration-properties/output-format.md): Configure the MongoDB Kafka source connector output format for data published to Kafka topics, including key, value, JSON formatter, and schema settings.
- [Startup Properties](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/configuration-properties/startup.md): Configure startup properties for the MongoDB Kafka source connector, including startup mode, pipeline filters, and thread settings for copying existing data.
- [Source Connector Fundamentals](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/fundamentals.md): Explore how to configure MongoDB Kafka source connector features for real-time data updates and schema application.
- [Change Streams](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/fundamentals/change-streams.md): Learn about using change streams in a MongoDB Kafka source connector to receive real-time updates on data changes and configure them with aggregation pipelines.
- [JSON Formatters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/fundamentals/json-formatters.md)
- [Apply Schemas](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/fundamentals/specify-schema.md): Learn how to apply key and value schemas to incoming documents in a MongoDB Kafka source connector, using default or specified schemas for structured data.
- [Usage Examples](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/usage-examples.md): Explore how to configure the Kafka source connector for tasks like filtering change streams, listening to multiple collections, and customizing topic names.
- [Copy Existing Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/usage-examples/copy-existing-data.md): Copy data from a MongoDB collection to an Apache Kafka topic using the Kafka source connector, with options to filter specific documents.
- [Customize a Pipeline to Filter Change Events](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/usage-examples/custom-pipeline.md): Configure a pipeline to filter change events for a MongoDB Kafka source connector, focusing on specific insert operations and document fields.
- [Listen for Changes on Multiple Sources](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/usage-examples/multiple-sources.md): Configure a MongoDB Kafka source connector to listen for change events on multiple collections and publish them to a Kafka topic using aggregation pipelines.
- [Specify a Schema](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/usage-examples/schema.md): Configure your MongoDB Kafka source connector to apply a custom schema for consistent data structure in Kafka topics, ensuring reliable data formatting.
- [Topic Naming](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/source-connector/usage-examples/topic-naming.md): Configure your MongoDB Kafka source connector to customize Kafka topic names using prefixes, suffixes, namespace maps, regex, and wildcards.
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/troubleshooting.md): Address issues encountered while running the MongoDB Kafka Connector, including recovering from invalid resume tokens and resetting connector offsets.
- [Invalid Resume Token](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/troubleshooting/recover-from-invalid-resume-token.md): Recover from an invalid resume token in a MongoDB Kafka source connector by tolerating errors temporarily or resetting stored offsets.
- [Reset Connector Offsets](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/troubleshooting/reset-connector-offset.md): Learn how to reset the offsets for your MongoDB Kafka connector by modifying the associated Kafka consumer group offsets using command-line tools.
- [Tutorials](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/tutorials.md): Explore tutorials on using the Kafka Connector for tasks like setting up change streams, source and sink connectors, and data replication.
- [Explore MongoDB Change Streams](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/tutorials/explore-change-streams.md): Learn how to create and observe change streams on a MongoDB collection using a tutorial with Docker and PyMongo.
- [Migrate an Existing Collection to a Time Series Collection](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/tutorials/migrate-time-series.md): Learn how to convert an existing MongoDB collection to a time series collection using the Kafka Connector by configuring source and sink connectors.
- [Replicate Data with a Change Data Capture Handler](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/tutorials/replicate-with-cdc.md): Learn to replicate data using a change data capture handler with the MongoDB Kafka Connector, configuring source and sink connectors to synchronize collections.
- [Getting Started with the MongoDB Kafka Sink Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/tutorials/sink-connector.md): Configure a MongoDB Kafka sink connector to transfer data from an Apache Kafka topic to a MongoDB collection in this step-by-step tutorial.
- [Getting Started with the MongoDB Kafka Source Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/tutorials/source-connector.md): Learn how to configure a MongoDB Kafka source connector to read data from a change stream and publish it to an Apache Kafka topic in this tutorial.
- [Kafka Connector Tutorial Setup](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/tutorials/tutorial-setup.md): Set up a development environment using Docker for the MongoDB Connector for Apache Kafka tutorial, ensuring Docker and git are installed.
- [What's New](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/kafka-connector/current/whats-new.md): Discover the latest updates and features in the Kafka Connector, including new configurations, bug fixes, and support for custom authentication providers.
